ambiguities.alternative_sql: SELECT count(*) AS n, round(avg(t.fare_amount),2) AS mean_fare FROM trips t JOIN zones p ON t.pickup_location_id=p.location_id JOIN zones d ON t.dropoff_location_id=d.location_id WHERE t.source_month='2025-02' AND p.borough='Manhattan' AND d.borough='Staten Island'
ambiguities.rationale: 题面只问 Manhattan 上车、Staten Island 下车的行程数与平均车费，没有要求排除负车费。历史金标额外使用 fare_amount>=0，结果为 243 条、77.26；不加该过滤的可复核结果为 251 条、72.81。仅因这一口径差异不能自动判错或判对，需人工复核最终回答与所用口径。
